objective: Move one qualified Commander demand signal across the external-action boundary without manufacturing commerce.

source.demand_signal: Current first-Commander / deck-building help requests remain observable.
source.note: This is a contextual demand surface, not evidence of buyer intent for DreamLedger.

exact_human_action: Post one genuinely helpful, non-spammy reply in a currently relevant Commander/deck-building thread. Mention the NZ$29 diagnostic only if it is directly relevant to the poster's stated problem. Do not mass-post, scrape users, or imply endorsement.
prepared_reply: You’re describing the exact sort of problem I built a small Commander deck diagnostic for: if you already have a decklist, I can go through the weak spots, expensive choices, cuts and upgrades and give you a clear direction rather than just handing you another generic decklist. It’s NZ$29 for a proper pass. If you’d rather keep it free, posting the list and your budget will still get you useful advice from the community.
evidence_required: Native Reddit permalink or screenshot showing the actual posted contribution
Stripe payment_intent.succeeded for an attributable buyer
Independent evidence sufficient for Truth Oracle verification
kill_condition: Do not post if the thread rules prohibit commercial/self-promotional replies or if the reply would not be genuinely useful without the offer.
